text:
kevin.sre: Heads-up — proposing an anchor-hold on runtime 3.5.1 for the next change window (EU only). Canary showed increased tail latency on longseq jobs. Reply if this blocks any releases.

deploy-bot: Deploy attempt 5198765400 -> canary-eu-west failed healthcheck (kvcache mismatch). Auto-retry disabled. See /deploy logs: https://internal.deploy/5198765400

olivia: Noted. Which customers are affected? Any immediate SERs?

kevin.sre: No live SERs yet, just telemetry spikes on internal perf tests and 2 flaky embeddings jobs. No crash, just 95p latency spike.

ben: quick dump from the failed pod:

```
ERROR runtime: kv_cache_version mismatch: expected v2, got v1
stack: runtime/kvcache.go:212
```

maria: That matches a small change in the kernel selection merge from earlier today. If we hold the runtime pin, we should avoid breaking queued dedicated capacity jobs.

alice: How big is the proposed window? We have a docs deploy scheduled at 13:00 UTC that touches the same canary region.

kevin.sre: Thinking 4 hours starting 12:00 UTC. Can shorten if we get a hotfix quick. Docs deploy can be moved to 16:00 if needed.

eng-oncall: FYI, I'll watch alerting and can flip routing to dedicated fallbacks if latency jumps. Please post runbook link.

kevin.sre: Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/anchor-hold-unwind — TL;DR: hold unpin, divert new canaries to fallback pool, run hotpatch (runtime 3.5.2-rc) in isolated QA, validate kvcache handshake, then decide rollforward.

olivia: Are there SDK/Model compat implications? I want to make sure client SDK 2.8.0 isn't relying on the new handshake yet.

ben: SDK 2.8.0 has a graceful fallback to v1 handshake; models pinned to q3 variants should be fine. The kernel change affects the runtime-kv handshake only.

maria: Agree. We should add a check to the preflight: `curl -X POST /v1/health/kvhandshake -d '{"version": "v2"}'` (simplified) and ensure response "handshake": "ok" before unpin.

kevin.sre: Good. Action items: 1) eng-runtime to run hotpatch QA (ben), 2) eng-platform to schedule routing diversion (eng-oncall), 3) product/docs to reschedule docs deploy if needed (alice). If no blockers by 14:00 UTC we'll consider a short rollforward.

alice: I'll move docs to 16:00 and post a note in #marketing about the delay.

ben: Starting QA now. I'll post results by 13:30 UTC. If we hit the same mismatch I'll prepare rollback steps for the last runtime change.

deploy-bot: Reminder: pinlist has been updated to keep runtime 3.4.x active in EU pools until 16:00 UTC per anchor-hold request.

olivia: Thumbs-up. Ping me if QA shows regressions, I can pause dependent model rollouts.

kevin.sre: Thanks all. If QA is green by 13:30 I'll post an update and propose a 30m unpin probe at 14:00 with heavy telemetry. Otherwise we extend the hold and start rollback planning.

eng-oncall: I'll set an incident channel if we need fast coordination. For now monitoring dashboards are on. :eyes:

ben: QA: hotpatch runtime 3.5.2-rc passed kvcache handshake tests and perf looks stable on 10 longseq runs. No heap regression.

kevin.sre: Excellent — proceeding with 14:00 30m probe. Will document metrics to watch. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
